municipalities.policy: Accept only municipality_codine values already resolved by the EGIF official linked-data dictionary and present in the canonical official municipality catalogue; do not use textual similarity.

causes.mapping_basis: Exact EGIF source codes and their official public dictionary labels; 2xx are negligence subcauses and 3xx are accidental subcauses.
